correctness.rationale: The full-cube parity identity A²=δI and half-rank square-zero compression lemma establish rank(B+δI)=N/2; two removed neighbor columns satisfy B²=δI+aaᵀ+bbᵀ, their Gram matrix is (δ+edge)I, and Ba=edge·b, Bb=edge·a. These exact identities determine every Jordan chain and the explicit d=2 opposite-pair boundary. Period/entry populations follow from nilpotent kernels and periodic eigenspaces. Standalone rank and labelled-state enumerations passed 35 parameter pairs and 65,736 initial states. Proof, rather than finite sample, covers all d and all characteristic-two finite fields.

value.rationale: A natural question about two failed sites of an excitable additive network receives a sharp four-regime all-size classification, with adjacency controlling whether the system is nilpotent, reversibly four-periodic, or transient to one/two-cycles. Precise closed-form state and orbit populations distinguish different failure geometries, and the comparison to one-vertex deletion clarifies a structurally nontrivial jump beyond renaming a known result.
